pythonFunction.name: get_ebill_flag
pythonFunction.description:
Says whether the customer is enrolled in eBill; it sets the default delivery for a duplicate
bill (email when enrolled, mail otherwise). Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and ebil_flag.
